name: Pusztaapáti (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pusztaapáti (a blue and green shield with a stag between pine trees and crossed axes) below the name PUSZTAAPÁTI in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
